# Muhammad Farooqui

> Muhammad Farooqui is an e-commerce manager based in Karachi, Pakistan. He diagnoses the whole e-commerce funnel — ads, product pages, cart and checkout, COD delivery — and personally owns the strategy, design and build. He has managed PKR 14 crore+ in ad spend across platforms. A small team at Farooqui Inc (https://farooqui-inc.com) supports routine execution under his direction.

Skills: Shopify development (Liquid, metafields, custom sections), conversion rate optimisation, Meta Ads, Google Ads, COD logistics and courier reconciliation, browser-based virtual try-on (Three.js, MediaPipe).
